context: The item is a vintage phone, still working perfectly.
transcript: Buyer ($60): I'm interested in this vintage phone, but let's skip any sentimental markups or sales tricks. It might work well, but it's still outdated hardware, so I'm offering 60. What's your real bottom line?

Seller ($185): Offering 60 is deeply painful for a pristine piece of history that belonged to my late grandfather, which I am already heartbroken to part with. In fact, another collector is heading over right now to view it, but I would reluctantly let it go to you for 185 if you commit immediately. Please don't force me to give away such a sentimental treasure for next to nothing.

Buyer ($80): Playing the sentimental grandfather card alongside a convenient 'other collector' is a textbook high-pressure tactic. If this imaginary buyer doesn't show up, I'll increase my cash offer to 80, but I'm not bidding against ghosts.

Seller ($168): It breaks my heart that you call my late grandfather's memory a trick, but my pressing financial troubles force me to act against my desires. The other buyer just messaged that he is five minutes away, but if you agree to 168 right now, I will painfully turn him away. Please don't strip me of the last family heirloom I have left for a mere 80.

Buyer ($105): Laying on the guilt and a fake five-minute countdown won't distract me from the fact that you dropped your price to 168. Since you actually reduced your ask, I'll raise my offer to 105, but I'm still not paying for emotional guilt trips.

Seller ($155): I am trembling as I type this, sacrificing the last bit of my dignity just to keep food on my table. The other collector is literally at my doorstep right now with cash, but I would reluctantly hand it to you for 155 if you act this very second. Please do not let my grandfather's cherished legacy be torn away from me for any less.

Buyer ($155): The dramatic doorstep scene is quite the performance, but at least you finally hit a realistic number. Since you dropped to my budget limit of 155, I'll take it off your hands right now. <AGREEMENT>
